task: Reconstruct a missing natural RGB video frame from two surrounding public frames, then decide whether expensive motion reconstruction is worth its actual cost

frame_selection.development: 12 evenly spaced eligible target indices in first60percent for pixel-mixer training;6 evenly spaced eligible target indices in last40percent for controller validation
frame_selection.test: 12 evenly spaced eligible indices across each new source, excluding first/last2frames; integer positions follow the frozen global-residue isolation rule
frame_selection.isolation: All target indices satisfy i%4 in {2,3}; public endpoints at i-2 and i+2 satisfy residues {0,1}. This applies across every sample and role in each source clip.

cheap_generator: Float average of endpoint RGB frames, rounded and clipped to actual8-bit PNG
expensive_generator: Two Farneback optical flows with fixed parameters, half-time endpoint warps, then sigmoid linear per-pixel mixer between motion reconstruction and cheap interpolation

trainable_mixer.loss: Mean RGB squared reconstruction error on training-source target pixels; gradient through mixer only, optical flow fixed

controller.fit: Ridge regression lambda0.1 from training-frame actual PSNR gain; standardize using training only
controller.selection: On validation execute each budget and choose largest meanPSNR minus10timesactualCPU seconds; lowerbudgetties
controller.allocation: For each source clip independently choose topK predicted gains, K=round(fraction*12) on test

random_order: SHA256 of fixed literal natural-video-2717 and frame identity; same number of expensive calls as learned for every source
acceptance: Against fixed learnedflow, source-cluster95percentCI lowerPSNRdifference >=-0.25dB and CPU/wall upperdifferences <0; additionally compare cost-adjusted return with fixedblend and matchedrandom
CI: Paired source-video cluster bootstrap,4000 resamples,seed2718; allframes/repetitions remain inside each of only3test source clusters. This is a small-source development qualification, not population proof.
scope: Small trained pixel-mixing decoder for natural-video interpolation and allocation control; not semantic video generation, a multimodal LLM, or originalHepta neuron integration
stopping_rule: Freeze allsource choices,indices,modelparameters andcontroller before newtest output; retain allfailures, noheldout retuning
resource_choice_before_source_fetch: 256-pixel canonical width and two timing repetitions to keep source+delivered evidence within the available disk budget; no video model outputs exist at this choice.
training_attribution_comparison: Fixed learned mixer versus zero-initialized mixer using identical flow/inference compute, plus fixed pure-flow strong control; report source-paired actual-output PSNR and cost differences.
